rename.from: Anonymous filters aggregation returns a named result  when a bool query is specified
rename.to: Anonymous filters aggregation returns a named result when filters contain a bool query

body:
> The content of the bool query doesn't seem to matter, as longs as there's at least one bool query in the array of filters, the result is wrong. I used an empty bool as an example for the sake of shortness

@TrustNoOne thanks for opening this issue, I can reproduce the reported behaviour for empty bool query, however if I add a clause (e.g. a "must" clause) the response is as expected (without numeric key). Just adding this as a datapoint, the behaviour for an empty bool query is still stange and needs investigation.

issue.title: Range aggregation support (results + keyed)

repository.name: elastic4s
repository.description: 🔍 Elasticsearch Scala Client - Reactive, Non Blocking, Type Safe, HTTP Client

issue.body: I added support for keyed and unkeyed range aggregation results and keyed date rage aggregations

body: So this is what I think happens here: the empty bool query gets rewritten internally to a MatchAllQueryBuilder, and as a follow up FiltersAggregationBuilder#doRewrite creates a new FiltersAggregationBuilder which doesn't correctly copy the original "keyed" field. I think that's the root cause of this and I will start working on a fix.

issue.title: Fix preserving FiltersAggregationBuilder#keyed field on rewrite

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently FiltersAggregationBuilder#doRewrite creates a new FiltersAggregationBuilder which doesn't correctly copy the original "keyed" field if a non-keyed filter gets rewritten.
This can cause rendering bugs of the output aggregations like the one reported in #27841.

Closes #27841

body: @TrustNoOne thanks for reporting this, good catch. And thanks for the detailed description, it was easy to reproduce that way. Fix will be in next 6.1 release and onwards.
sure thing! thanks for fixing it that fast
